title: 皐月賞の後に・プリテンディング

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin comes away from the Satsuki Sho victorious. Her fierce competitive spirit simply proves to be too much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Biwa Hayahide can fill the gaps in her calculations, she can win. But no matter what solution she thinks up, premonitions of defeat plague her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide is shaken. Beside her, Winning Ticket stays strong and boldly declares her intention to win the Japanese Derby no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Can we rebuild Biwa Hayahide's winning equation in time for the Derby, where the three of them will meet once more?
